You enter the barn of the deserted ranch cautiously. You've come here after hearing reports that the owners haven't been seen or heard from in over a week, and now that you're here, it's easy to see why. The place seems abandoned, with no sign of the rancher or any other humans, and the cows are loose in the fields, clearly not being looked after.
As you cautiously enter the barn, you see no sign of trouble...at first. But subtle movement from over the top of one of the cattle stalls catch your eye. Something truly massive is moving around back there...
Hefting your sword, you round the corner into the stall to discover a huge woman, kneeling down and lazily chewing at the straw with an exhausted look on her face.
"Oh!" she says, finally noticing you after a moment's delay as you enter her field of view. "It's another human!"
She perks up slightly, leaning back and giving you a good view of her large body, a least twice the size of a normal man. It's a thick, pale-skinned female form, her beautiful face framed by pretty blonde hair, cow ears and small horns. Her thighs and hips are wide and inviting, but the crowning feature of her body is her truly enormous breasts, which jiggle suggestively as she presses them together with her arms.
"Have you come to feed me, like the others?"
It seems likely as you examine her that this odd creature is at the root of the recent disappearances, and you can even catch the potent smell of succubus pheromones on the air. Yet strangely, you sense only genuine warmth and relief coming from her smile, not the killer instincts of a monster. Perhaps she knows more about what happened here.
